boundary.description: From the point where Agecroft Road crosses the railway, S along Salford Crescent – Clifton railway then by a bee-line to Salford Crescent – Swinton railway to Laundry Street. W along Laundry Street, Nave Court, Charles Street, Broad Street and by a bee-line to Chasely Road, Eccles Old Road, Claremont Road, Cholmondeley Road, N along Lancaster Road and along Sunningdale Drive and Welwyn Drive (including both sides of these roads), E along East Lancashire Road and Manchester road. Then by a bee-line NE to and along Highfiled Drive, Fairway, NW along Bolton Road and Agevroft Road to the point it crosses the railway.
